supersession_reason: The ADNI3 target endpoints and v2 results are already revealed. V3 therefore uses untouched ADNI1/GO/2 values as a cohort-phase-held-out replication and never describes them as a new endpoint-held-out analysis.
scientific_question: Which ADNI3 pathway-imaging-outcome chains replicate with the prespecified component directions in independently phase-held-out ADNI1/GO/2 participants?

cohort.independence_statement: ADNI1/GO/2 subjects are disjoint from the ADNI3 development phase. Endpoint definitions are already known, but ADNI1/GO/2 association estimates have not been accessed.

allowed_uses: lock the independent-replication family using the sealed ADNI3 v2 selection rule
lock the expected a-path, b-path, and indirect-effect directions
diagnostic testing of analysis code without ADNI1/GO/2 effect estimates
forbidden_uses: exposing development-selected candidate identities or directions to any generator
selection or tuning using ADNI1/GO/2 association strength
retuning thresholds after ADNI1/GO/2 outcomes are revealed

confirmation_data.outcome_direction: annualized_decline_score is oriented so that positive values indicate worsening

development_selection.selection_rule: nominal_chain_hit is true and a_path_p, b_path_p, and sobel_p are each below 0.05 in the sealed ADNI3 v2 result

pathway_exposures.selection_rule: one available score per pathway; prefer p1em03, then p5em02, then lexical score_name

candidate_universe.construction: Cartesian product of selected pathway exposure, imaging marker, and target outcome
candidate_universe.public_registry_rule: The 210 candidate identities are public to all methods; development labels, directions, effects, P values, and ranks are not.
candidate_universe.exclusions_after_freeze: Only prespecified non-estimability or minimum-sample exclusions are allowed; excluded candidates retain their original rank and count as unsuccessful for generator metrics.

statistics.model: the unchanged standardized covariate-adjusted linear association-based indirect-effect model from v2
statistics.primary_scientific_endpoint: For a registered replication candidate, a-path, b-path, and indirect-effect estimates must match all three frozen directions; each component one-sided P must be below 0.05; and the indirect-effect one-sided P must additionally pass Holm FWER below 0.05 across the four registered candidates.
statistics.replication_multiplicity_method: Holm family-wise error correction across the four frozen ADNI3-selected candidates
secondary_full_universe_endpoints: two-sided pathway-outcome family-FDR chain hit across all 210 candidates
two-sided global-FDR chain hit across all 210 candidates
prespecified continuous held-out chain-evidence score for ranking evaluation
statistics.family_definition: all prespecified imaging-marker mediators within one pathway exposure and one clinical outcome
statistics.scientific_reporting_rule: The four-candidate directional Holm replication is the primary scientific test. Full-universe family/global FDR and graded ranking metrics are secondary and cannot replace a failed primary replication.

generator_evaluation.data_boundary: All generators receive only the public 210-candidate registry, the pinned KG snapshot, and method-native public context. The private four-candidate replication registry and every ADNI3/ADNI1/GO/2 result field are evaluator-only.
generator_evaluation.baseline_rule: Each baseline produces and freezes a complete static SearchPolicy before any ADNI1/GO/2 association estimate is accessed.
generator_evaluation.neurodiscovery_rule: NeuroDiscovery freezes its initial policy before access, then hash-commits each next batch using only outcomes from earlier executed ADNI1/GO/2 batches.
generator_evaluation.invalid_candidate_rule: Invalid, duplicate, missing, or non-estimable candidates consume their generated or ranked slot and are scored as unsuccessful.
primary_metrics: area under the cumulative recovery curve for independently replicated registered candidates
normalized discounted cumulative gain from the prespecified continuous held-out chain-evidence score
secondary_metrics: full-universe family-FDR and global-FDR Hit@K and recall@K
AUROC and AUPRC when the corresponding binary endpoint has both classes
experiments required to reach each attainable replication-recall target
generator_evaluation.comparison: paired across the ten prespecified run indices using confidence intervals and one-sided paired randomization P values, with Holm correction across NeuroDiscovery-versus-baseline comparisons
generator_evaluation.clear_sota_rule: NeuroDiscovery is called clear SOTA only when it exceeds every baseline on both primary metrics with positive paired effects, lower 95% confidence bounds above zero, and Holm-adjusted one-sided paired-randomization P below 0.05. A metric with no identifiable variation cannot support a clear-SOTA claim.

freeze_semantics.temporal_kg_freeze_definition: Not applicable: this is a cohort-phase-held-out replication, not hindcasting, and no historical publication cutoff is imposed.
freeze_semantics.kg_snapshot_pinning_definition: The current canonical KG and claim-store bytes are hash-pinned for reproducibility; this is snapshot pinning, not a temporal freeze.
freeze_semantics.initial_ranking_freeze_definition: Every method commits an initial SearchPolicy before ADNI1/GO/2 association estimates are evaluated.
freeze_semantics.sequential_batch_commit_definition: For NeuroDiscovery, each adaptive next-batch ranking is committed using only outcomes from earlier executed batches.
